description: 鹿児島県内港湾へのクルーズ船寄港実績 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 鹿児島県. 鹿児島県内へのクルーズ船の寄港実績に関するデータです。. Coverage: 鹿児島県. The portal files it under the publisher 鹿児島県. Its tags are クルーズ, 鹿児島県. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2023-03-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
